source: Line Watch research, Nov 13, 2026: utility project pages, state commission dockets (LPSC, APSC, MPSC, PSCW, MN PUC, IUC, ND PSC, SD PUC, ICC, MoPSC, IURC), transmission owners' published plans (ATC 10-Year Assessment, Entergy quarterly status reports on OASIS, Minnesota Biennial Report, Ameren Missouri IRP). Each project lists its own sources.
note: Kept by hand from four research passes (MISO South; Wisconsin and Michigan; Minnesota, Dakotas, Iowa; Illinois, Missouri, Indiana, Kentucky). misoenergy.org was not used.
